criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Frames 2, 3, 7 and 8 strong at 432 px. Frame 5 is a tan cardboard slab in the grey middle with a flat ring for a mark, frame 4's arm is stacked primitives with the TEST station cut off, frame 9's bar is under a quarter of the frame with a dead band above, frame 1's right copper is a flat peach plane and its domes band.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One deck with a describable spine, one alloy through its states, the blue mark returning. Frame 5 strobes the value track and frame 1's warm right half is the other outlier.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces. Frame 6's kicker 'Two funders, one unit' with frames 7 and 9 lets a feed reader conclude NSF co-funds the foundry, which no claim says and the caption calls a separate award. Frame 5's 'conceived the foundry' rests on truncated quotes.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who pays and who conceived it are clear. No place below Texas A&M, no date, the Texan stake unstated, frame 9's action buried in the dek, the Woods being Aggies dropped.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover earns the swipe and frame 2 pays. The premise arrives on frame 8 after the detour through the federal award, so the turn comes late. Frame 5 could go.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and honest. Frame 3's spec sheet line, press release phrasing on the foundation, 'Drawn to illustrate.' nine times, 'Two funders, one unit' as jargon, no Texas texture.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: The bench macro and the reliefs are fresh. Money as units in wells at a drawing unit repeats no. 63, and frame 7 is counted bars despite the art plan.

one_sentence_fix: Make the close tell a Texan what to do, change frame 6's kicker so the NSF award reads as a separate platform, and spend a frame on the Texas stake the sources support.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A pale tan slab in the grey middle, about 40 visible sheet lines for 100, a flat ring for the mark.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Bench height three quarter view on the shadow side, rake only the sheet edges, run the stack off the left edge, a thin pen stroke for the mark.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A toy arm of boxes and cylinders, the crucible cropped left, the TEST station clipped right.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Reframe tighter on the gripper holding a button over the glowing pocket with the grips inside the right third, rebuild the arm links as castings.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The bar under a quarter of the frame with a dead band of about 380 px above it.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Scale the bar about 1.6 times, fracture near centre, grips running off both edges.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The right copper a flat bright peach plane and terraced dome banding.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Lower the copper fill so the right falls dark with one sweep, smooth ripple normals on the domes.
